findings.claim: Malformed or incomplete code could earn completion and credit: the checker accepted fragments without the required starter scaffolding, class, method or body.
findings.recommendation: Make the existing bounded checker reject deleted scaffolding and require the surrounding declaration before credit, without a parser or hidden verifier.

findings.claim: The traversing-method objective covered only toString and elicited no explanation for equals and hashCode.
findings.recommendation: Add a short classification across toString, equals and hashCode.

findings.claim: The initial and no-JavaScript topic-bar duration disagreed with the canonical required minutes.
findings.recommendation: Author the label from the same canonical minutes as data-pep-required-minutes.

findings.claim: Literal Markdown emphasis markers were visible in the HTML teaching.
